facts.fact: The government cloud portal run by ANPTIC (Ministry of Digital Transition) states that the G-Cloud infrastructure, with 4 datacenters and 8 cloud nodes, hosts 139 websites and 622 virtual machines and runs government applications (state messaging, gov.bf directory, Oracle business applications such as SIGASPE and E-conseil des ministres); the page is undated, so as_of is its 2026-08-05 capture date.
